newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: New Dutch fund offers investors a punt on ferries.
newsitem.headline: New Dutch fund offers investors a punt on ferries.

text.p: Dutch investors eager to sidestep tax charges now have the opportunity to invest in ships in a new fund from ABN AMRO bank, the company said on Friday.
"For ABN, this is the first speciality fund," an ABN AMRO spokesman said.

In conjunction with P&O North Sea Ferries, part of the Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co, private investors will be able to invest in the company Norships and its two ferries, the Norsun and the Norbank, for seven years. P&O will rent the ships on a time charter.
"The fiscal authorities consider these investors as entrepreneurs," said an ABN AMRO spokesman.

The investment structure is designed to appeal to Dutch residents of 48 years or older who are expected to benefit from the tax treatment and see a net return on their investment of 10-14 percent per year.
Registration began on Friday and will close on March 3
